$Comment: Old Jack's side quest: go into the Horseman's Graveyard through the Gravekeeper beside him and
bring the Headless Horseman down, then report back. It is offered only on Old Jack's quest list
(his "What needs doing?"), never by a line of his conversation; while it is being carried, his
conversation opens on his rider line, which says where the Gravekeeper stands and how the head
works, and once it is done he asks for the hand-in. The _Hallows_Eve folder makes the id
ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names his fight's script, never a creature, so it holds through his change of
form, and every player the fight credits counts the win, however many fought; only players
carrying the quest when he falls move it. Npc.TurnInId, which the Parent sets, adds the
report-back step to Old Jack, and he stands in the Forgotten Temple for the whole season.
Requires opens it once a player has finished Lanterns in the Temple, or Pumpkin Patch for a
player who went straight to Old Jack's questline. Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in each
Hallow's Eve (Times is how often one run takes it), so a returning player rides against him again
next October; one left unfinished when the event ends waits for the next.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the fight, paid only where that mod runs. Its
own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without it, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Old_Jack_Horseman
